issues.description: Problem statement asks for the number (count) of swimming pools in municipalities with more than 1000 female inhabitants, but the solution query returns the names of the Schwimmbad rows instead of an aggregated count. This mismatch between the expected output type (a single numeric count) and the provided solution output (multiple name rows) will confuse students and cause automated checks to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution query to return an aggregated count instead of individual Schwimmbad names. For example: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Schwimmbad, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel AND Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000; Ensure the solution file aufgabe04.sql contains this COUNT query so it matches the problem requirement.
